description: Arknights PC · Operator Mods, open-source loading and resource conversion

cursor.title: Mouse cursor
cursor.hint: Switch while the game is closed. Takes effect next launch. Turning this off restores the game cursor.
cursor.enabled: System cursor enabled. Takes effect next launch.
cursor.restored: Game cursor restored. Takes effect next launch.
cursor.gameRunning: Close Arknights before switching the cursor.
cursor.unsupported: No supported cursor resource was found. Update the game and check again.
cursor.missing: The cursor resource is missing. Turn this off to try restoring the backup.
cursor.componentMissing: The system cursor component is missing. Reinstall or build the component.
cursor.componentInvalid: System cursor component verification failed. Reinstall or build the component.
cursor.operationFailed: The cursor operation failed. Check the resources and try again.

reloaded: Updated {{bundleCount}} affected bundles. Leave and reopen the operator view. Cached scenes may require a scene change.
reloadToggleFailed: The Mod's enabled state was saved, but in-game reload did not complete: {{error}}
analyzing: Reading the Mod and comparing current game resources…
summary: {{count}} resources, {{matched}} matched to the current game, {{renamed}} names can be repaired.
created: Created {{name}} with {{count}} resources, disabled by default.
copyHint: The original Mod is preserved. Review the new copy before enabling it. Matching names does not verify the in-game appearance.
libraryHint: Imported Mods start disabled. Convert mobile or legacy AB Mods first. After launching through the updated QAQR loader, toggling a Mod updates its affected bundles. You can also right-click Reload this Mod. Leave and reopen the operator view; cached scenes may require a scene change.
syncFailed: M4A sync failed: {{error}}. Correct the problem and sync again in game settings.
selectionHint: A bundle may contain several outfits. Select the outfits or resources to include. Differences from the current game may also come from game updates and do not establish the author's changes.

settings.libraryHint: Stores all Mods organized by operator. Enabled resources are used to build separate PC bundles.
settings.title: Loader
settings.loaderHint: The loader and converter are built from the Arknights-Mod-Tools repository.
settings.prepared: Prepared {{bundleCount}} PC bundles without starting the game.
settings.destinationHint: Enabled resources are synced here, then applied to separate copies of current PC bundles. Original game files are read-only.
settings.sourceHint: Submodules track upstream branches. Every build records its actual commits and artifact hashes.
settings.workerReady: Resource diagnostics and conversion are available
settings.workerMissing: Source-built resource component is missing. Operator and Mod library management remain available.
settings.readOnly: Diagnostics, conversion and preparation only read game files. Generated PC bundles stay in the QAQR data directory.

warnings.dimensionsChanged: The old Mod and current resource have different dimensions. Original images and atlases are preserved; verify compatibility in-game
warnings.bundleCompanion: The purpose of this companion file is unverified; omitted from bundle conversion
warnings.resourceOnly: Only selected images and Spine resources are exported. Current PC bundles provide the template; unselected resources, materials, animation, scripts and audio are preserved. Differences in old bundles require manual review.
warnings.noBaseline: No game executable selected. Resources can be exported, but current-version mappings are unverified.
warnings.unmatched: Some resources have no current match. Their names are preserved rather than guessed.
warnings.baselineUnreadable: Some current game resources could not be read
warnings.ambiguousSpine: Spine direction or purpose is ambiguous; skipped
warnings.multiPage: Complex multi-page Spine conversion is not supported; skipped
warnings.unsupportedFile: Unsupported file omitted from the copy

errors.reloadNotRunning: Start Arknights using the QAQR loader before reloading a Mod.
errors.reloadUnavailable: The running game is not connected to a loader that supports single-Mod reload. Restart it once using the updated QAQR loader.
errors.reloadUnsupported: This game build lacks the interfaces required for single-Mod reload. Regular loading remains available.
errors.invalidManifest: The resource manifest contains invalid, missing, duplicate or out-of-root files. Analyze the Mod again and create a new copy.
errors.selectionRequired: Select the resources to include before creating a copy.
errors.link: Mod and loading directories cannot contain symbolic links or junctions.
errors.gameWrite: The Arknights game directory is read-only. Choose a Mod library outside it.
errors.tooLarge: Too many or oversized resources. Process one operator Mod at a time.
errors.convertFirst: This Mod contains Unity bundles. Create a PC copy from its context menu before enabling it.
errors.noResources: No supported M4A or Unity Mod resources found.
errors.collision: Duplicate resource inside this Mod: {{name}}. Resolve the conflict first.
errors.conflict: Resource {{name}} is used by multiple Mods: {{mods}}. Disable the conflicting Mod first.
errors.overlap: The Mod library and generated resource directories cannot overlap.
errors.unowned: The loading directory contains files not owned by QAQR. Overwrite stopped.
errors.gameMissing: Select a valid Arknights.exe in game settings.
errors.componentMissing: The source-built Arknights component is missing. Rebuild or install Arknights-Mod-Tools.
errors.componentInvalid: The Arknights component differs from its build manifest. Rebuild or reinstall it.
errors.gameRunning: Exit Arknights before preparing new PC bundles.
errors.workerMissing: The Arknights resource conversion component is not installed.
errors.timeout: Resource processing timed out. Try a smaller Mod.
errors.modMissing: The Mod is missing or has moved. Refresh the list.
errors.changed: The Mod, game settings or analysis has changed. Analyze again before creating a copy.
errors.busy: Another Arknights operation is running. Try again shortly.
errors.launchMode: Arknights PC uses the source-built QAQR Arknights Loader.
errors.approvalSave: Could not save the conflict confirmation. The previous enabled state was restored.
errors.workerDependencyMissing: The offline analyzer is missing {{name}}. Redeploy the complete Arknights tools.
errors.workerExited: The offline analyzer could not start (exit code {{code}}). Check that the Arknights tools are complete.
